comments.author: rflamary
comments.body:
Hello @sztankatt 

The error is probably due to a memory problem (the memory allocation fails).

Note that due to the architecture of the C++ solver we need to copy i memory the cost matrix which can fail if the memory cannot fit the copy.

comments.author: sztankatt
comments.body:
Hi @rflamary! Thanks for the reply. I am running the code on a big server (1.5TB memory), so should have enough memory.

Could it be that somehow in my python code I mess up the memory allocation of C++?

Otherwise, I have no idea how to fix this...

comments.author: rflamary
comments.body:
Humm, it's hard to know, if it comes from the underlying C++ code it's hard to find the erreor.  Could you try and find at which size of problem things explode? I recall running it on 50kx50k with some tinkerring of nitermax.

Aslo try giving the emd functions some proper weights from ot.unif . It is probably not the problem but it's worth trying.
